CrossMux 1.5.2 adds a standalone AirPage experience, a new cover-carousel theme, selectable OTA channels, and more reliable reading and network behavior.

## Apps and interface

- Moved AirPage from a standby face into a standalone app with manual and live delivery, a 20-image history, and optional custom sleep-screen updates.
- Added the Lyra Carousel built-in theme and fixed RoundedRaff cover selection when continuing the current book.
- Added Stable and Nightly OTA channel selection while keeping Nightly builds separate from stable releases.

## WeRead

- Made progress synchronization explicit and reliable, including last-write verification and clearer local/remote choices.
- Added a first-use disclaimer that must be accepted before entering the unofficial WeRead client.

## Reader and reliability

- Synced upstream reader, rendering, networking, storage, dictionary, simulator, and translation improvements through `9163149a`.
- Improved CJK spacing, ruby continuation, and `<br>` pagination, and hardened resource cleanup and SD-card access.
- Clarified the Simplified Chinese SD-font Flash preload prompt.

## Upgrade notes

- Existing books and reading progress are preserved.
- EPUB section cache versions are now 48 for international builds and 49 for Chinese builds. Affected pagination caches rebuild automatically on first open.

> **WeRead security notice:** WeRead uses an unofficial Web protocol that may change without notice. Device traffic is encrypted with wolfSSL, but the current client does not verify the server CA or host identity. Use WeRead only on a trusted network.

## Firmware assets

- `firmware.bin` — international firmware
- `firmware-cn.bin` — Simplified Chinese firmware
- `bootloader.bin` and `partitions.bin` — complete web/USB flashing support

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0x1abin/crossmux/compare/1.5.1...1.5.2
